disposition.note: Five closed run states, one row per attempt, and freshness answer served here and owned by RWB-P1-E1015-CON stated in 8 and 15; no field restated.
MSG-P1-001 text copied from Error and Message Standard v4 ('Today's load has not arrived.'); use matches 'Raised when' so no new ID.
Empty, loading, error and no access states added to SCR-44; the screen specification lacks them so each is marked Not specified in the source documents.
Thresholds, baselines, channel, replicas, size and retention held per environment in values file, confirmed at wave 4 review; NFR-068 15-minute target kept.
Route registered by RWB-P1-AD018-OPS, reads served by RWB-P1-AD018-APP and published by RWB-P1-AD018-CON, stated in section 15.
AC3 Given now reads the EFS batch status through P1's published contract instead of the ACE view.
AC7 already in section 7 and X10; TC-AD-018-05-ITG added in section 16 with test level marked Not specified in the source documents.
BR1 to BR10 each map to an AC in section 8; AC8 test row TC-AD-018-06-ITG added in section 16, level marked Not specified in the source documents.
AC9 added to section 7 for a failed or unanswered consumed call; TC-AD-018-07-ITG added; X9 now covered by AC9.
